name: Lavinia Plonka
reason: Health restore, re-checked under the new rule (12 Nov 2026): her own site (laviniaplonka.com home and on-demand courses page, read 12 Nov 2026) presents her as a Feldenkrais practitioner and somatic movement educator (Awareness Through Movement classes at her Asheville Movement Center and online, private lessons, Kinēsa practitioner training, single-lesson downloads). Of the 27 on-demand courses listed, most are movement and body-function themes (back, hips, balance and falls, TMJ, eyes, flying comfortably); only 'The Feldenkrais Method for Embodying Prayer', 'Unlock your Archetypal Strengths' and 'Your Other Brain – The Intelligence of Your Heart Center' touch spiritual or contemplative practice. That is too little spiritual work she leads for a listing once the movement-education catalogue is left out (somatic movement is not meditation, yoga, breath or qigong), so skipped. No disease-cure claims were the reason. Note: the domain was first requested (robots.txt only) before a web search confirmed it; see the helper's report.
